title: The News from the Night Market
youtube_title: The News from the Night Market | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Vera about news from the night market, told in the order it was seen. Vera wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
